name: job-search-agent
description: Seven Claude skills that find real, open jobs for your resume and score each one 0-100 with the reasons and the gaps: a full search across company job boards (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters), job portals (Remotive, Remote OK, Himalayas, Arbeitnow) and company career websites; a reviewed resume profile; a single-job matcher that also takes pasted LinkedIn or Naukri listings; a company watch list; a skill-gap report; an explainable ATS Readiness check of the resume file; and a resume optimizer that targets a job and fact-checks the rewrite so nothing is invented.
